data.desc: Oculis is a global biopharmaceutical company (Nasdaq: OCS; XICE: OCS) focused on breakthrough innovations to address significant unmet medical needs in neuro-ophthalmology, neurology, and ophthalmology. Oculis' highly differentiated late-stage clinical pipeline focuses on two core product candidates. Privosegtor is a breakthrough neuroprotective candidate in the PIONEER program, designed to support registrational plans across optic neuropathies, such as optic neuritis (ON) and NAION, as well as acute MS relapses. Privosegtor also offers potential for expansion into additional neuro-ophthalmic and neuro-axonal indications. Licaminlimab is a novel topical anti-TNF in a registrational trial and is being developed with a genotype-based approach to treat patients with TNFR1 dry eye disease.
